english.title: Economic operator fail to give assistance / information to officer under Motorcycles (Type-Approval) Regs 2018
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an economic operator, without reasonable cause, failed to give an officer, namely **(..SPECIFY OFFICER..), assistance or information which the officer reasonably required of you for the purposes of the exercise of the officer's functions under a provision of the Motorcycles (Type-Approval) Regulations 2018, namely **(..SPECIFY PROVISION..), in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to Paragraphs 1(b), 3(1)(a) and 9(1)(c) of Schedule 1 to the Motorcycles (Type-Approval) Regulations 2018.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The offence is not punishable under paragraph 3 if a penalty required by the enforcement authority has been paid, see paragraph 3(2) of the Motorcycles (Type-Approval) Regulations 2018.
(ii) 'Officer' in this offence means a person authorised by the enforcement authority to assist in enforcing these regulations and the Motorcycles Regulation.
